verdict.rationale: First-party docs say AnythingLLM can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure, with free Docker self-hosting, and that the desktop app runs entirely on your own computer. A public GitHub repo exists, and community users report installing it locally and deploying their own instance in an enterprise environment. Missing for 10: in-depth self-hosting/deployment documentation beyond pricing-page taglines (the evidence shows no setup or ops guide), explicit evidence of an open-source license.
